title: ecgppg-conformal: patient-specific conformal calibration for ECG-PPG arrhythmia monitoring
description: Code and per-record results for the paper 'Patient-specific conformal calibration for arrhythmia monitoring: contamination, reviewer dependence and distribution shift'. No patient data are included; the VitalDB Arrhythmia Database (PhysioNet) and the Vilnius database (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23187681) must be obtained from their providers.
